# v1.7.0

v1.7.0 expands marka.md from a markdown editor into a more capable local project workspace.

## added

- Added quick previews for images, PDF, audio, video, text, code, and office documents without leaving the app (#120).
- Added app-wide zoom shortcuts with persistence, reset, detached-preview support, and macOS traffic-light alignment (#123).

## improved

- Reworked folder watching to avoid startup and folder-add freezes caused by whole-tree watcher setup on macOS and Windows (#121, #122).
- Folder watcher registration is now incremental, with bounded refresh coalescing and safer cleanup of replaced watchers.

## thanks

- Thanks to [@beihai23](https://github.com/beihai23) for the quick file preview feature.
- Thanks to [@sashamerzliakov](https://github.com/sashamerzliakov) for the watcher performance fix and app-wide zoom feature.

## notes

- The signed updater setup is unchanged.
